title: You Are Hated And In Hell

sense.text:
“So of thy people was accepted both the salvation of the righteous, and destruction of the enemies.” Thy people are the Israelites and only the Israelites. You cannot include other nations into the nation of Israel. It is crystal clear by now that everybody should know that the so-called Negroes, Hispanics and Native Indians of slave descent are the biblical descendants of those Israelites.

“the salvation of the righteous” is one third of our people, because that is the only people that is going to be saved. And “destruction of the enemies” is the part that so-called Negroes have a humongous problem with. They want the other nations to be saved. They don't want the other nations destroyed. But God is not giving you an option. God is telling you crystal clear that you have to accept both.

Look at what is going on in the news: the whole situation with Nolan Wells, our people praying for justice, hoping justice comes, finding evidence of wrongdoing, and Esau just like, nah, we're not going to include that. So we are a hated people — not only in the United States of America, the Caribbean Islands, Europe, wherever the Most High scattered us, we are always at the bottom.

But we have to ask ourselves why this happened to us. Especially with the high holy day, the day of atonement, approaching us fast, we have to really examine ourselves, rethink ourselves, and we have to be honest. How did we offend God? Why do we suffer as a people? Why are we hated as a people so much? And why are we in this hellish condition? This is what the Bible is saying about who we are and what we must do to get out of the condition we are in.

“I said in mine heart concerning the estate of the sons of men, that God might manifest them, and that they might see that they themselves are beasts.” That they might see that they themselves are beasts — the sons of men. But are we truly sons of men? No. We are the sons of God.

So what happens when God chooses one people, gives them laws different from everybody else, and commands them not to live like everyone else? When we don't apply God's laws, and we don't study, pray and apply — spy, like Bishop likes to say — we are like beasts. There is no difference. We are no different than the animals in the wilderness, the animals in the safari. This truth, coming into this knowledge that we're the Israelites and applying God's laws, is supposed to transform us from the sons of men to the sons of God. The application of God's laws.

The nations already know it. Esau hides our history in those books that they possess, and their thought was that we were never going to come to the point where we could read as so-called free Negroes. That's why they made those books. That's why they put the truth in those books. It was never intended for us to be emancipated. It was never intended for us to learn how to read. Those books were made for white eyes only.

But when we come to the understanding of who we are, then we realize that we are the sons of God. We realize how special we are. Therefore we are the most hated. The most hated.

“For thou art an holy people unto the Lord thy God” — an holy people unto the Most High, meaning separate. The Most High never made us to be all inclusive. We were supposed to be joined unto him: special, separate, set apart.

“the Lord thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth.” Not equal to, not subordinate — above. Above all people that are upon the face of the earth, because the earth was created for us and everything in the earth was created for the Israelites. God said that we're supposed to be a special people when applying his laws, and that he's going to make us above all nations that are upon this earth.

This is something you should have your kids say every morning. Put it on your wall, let them see it, that we are a holy people, a special people.

The other nations know who we are, and they're not going to tell us. Although it's in their books, they're going to deny it to high hell. Although it's written in their books, they're still going to put the so-called white man in the land of Israel today up as the real Jews, when those are imposters. That is for the brothers and sisters tuning in online who are new, who are just finding out who they are.

precepts.why:
“For the whole creature in his proper kind was fashioned again anew, serving the peculiar commandments that were given unto them” — the peculiar commandments, meaning the strange or odd commandments, because our laws are different from the laws that the other nations have. Our laws are special.

“that thy children might be kept without hurt.” So when you're not following the commandments, what's going to happen to your children? They're going to be hurt, because God's laws is like a refuge. God's laws is what's supposed to protect us.

That is what makes us a special people unto himself. And because the laws are what was supposed to protect us, God tells us to make it known unto our children: pass down the testimony, pass down the laws.

“And thou shalt say unto Pharaoh, Thus saith the Lord, Israel is my son, even my firstborn.” This is going to Pharaoh of Egypt, but the Pharaoh of today is the so-called white man, here in Babylon the great, known as America.

Now, was Israel the firstborn? He was the last of nations created. He came out after Esau. He was the last one created. So why is it saying Israel is my firstborn? Because that's who he chose out of all those lines. And because of what the firstborn receives: all the inheritance and the blessings of the father.

That is why we are a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth.

“They shall come with weeping, and with supplications will I lead them: I will cause them to walk by the rivers of waters.” God is talking about the Israelites only here, not all nations.

“in a straight way, wherein they shall not stumble.” Because we stumbled here in America. We stumbled wherever we were scattered. We started to follow the religions and philosophies of the other nations. We strayed away from God. We stumbled in our walk. Now the Most High said he's going to make us walk a straight way.

“for I am a father to Israel, and Ephraim is my firstborn.” I am a father — that's what makes us sons of God, because Christ is our father, Christ is our God. To Israel, and Israel only. And Ephraim was not even the firstborn, but what God is telling you here is that all the inheritance is going to be for the Israelites.

There are many instances where the Most High repeats the same thing. Although we were the last of nations, the covenants, the promises, the kingdom of God and the inheritance belong to us. Why? Because we're joint heirs with Christ. When Christ returns, he's going to put everything under his feet, and we're going to share those resources with Christ.

“God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints” — and this whole chapter is bad. “The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him. And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.” He's going to throw them a beating. He's going to beat down our foes before our face, and plague them that hate him — hate us.

He's speaking to King David here, but he's also going into the offspring, the descendants of King David, whom we are. “But my faithfulness and my mercy shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted” — that's Christ. “I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers. He shall cry unto me, Thou art my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.”

“Also I will make him my firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.” This is what the nations hate about us: us being the firstborn of the Most High. So why are we hated? Because God chose us.

And that is very difficult for a so-called Negro to understand, because society does not treat us as if God loves us. We're always at the bottom. That's what Deuteronomy 28 is about — we are the ones that are suffering globally the curses of God. So it doesn't appear as if the Most High loves us, but he does love us, because he could have destroyed us, and he said he repented not. The Most High promised us that if we repent under his son, whom he sent to die only for the nation of Israel, we may get the kingdom of God.

“For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren, my kinsmen according to the flesh.” I wish I could take on the sufferings of Christ. This is Paul, the Apostle Paul, speaking from the tribe of Benjamin, a black man. Kinsmen, brothers. According to the flesh, meaning sex — not according to the spirit, not according to conversion.

“Who are Israelites; to whom pertaineth the adoption.” To whom pertaineth means who does this belong to? The Israelites. The adoption of what? Christ adopting us to the new covenant, only for the Israelites, not the Hamites, not the Moabites, not the Ammonites. You do not read that in the Bible. No matter what these apologists try to say, you don't read it in the Bible.

“and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of God, and the promises.” The glory is only for the Israelites. Covenants with an s — old and new — only belong to the Israelites. The giving of the law was only given to the Israelites.

Right now online somewhere you have a tatamite saying that Christ changed that. No, Christ ain't changed nothing. When Christ was walking on the earth, there was no such thing as a book of Matthew. Get it through your thick skull. There was no such thing as a book of Luke. There was no acts of the apostles. There was no Galatians, Ephesians. Christ always referenced the Old Testament. There's no contradiction in the Bible. The contradiction was placed there by Christianity, by all these different religions and philosophies. That's what causes us to be confused now.

“For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.” So when we start to apply God's laws, we are the sons of God.

It's not enough that we were chosen and given God's laws. We have to actually apply it to be the sons of God.

“In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.” You don't do righteousness if you don't apply.

If you're not applying it, you are the son of the devil. You're just like a heathen. You're going to get the same thing that they're going to get.

sense.text:
“And the fourth came, and overcame all the beasts that were past” — that's Rome. And we know America is an extension of Rome.

“and had power over the world with great fearfulness, and over the whole compass of the earth.” They had power over the whole world: military, economics, everything.

“with much wicked oppression” — that's that cruelty. The Edomite woman said it herself: the trauma of slavery comes down through the DNA, and so does the cruelty of slavery, the desire to hurt, the desire to steal and kill and humiliate and torment. She said that when you do something like that for long enough and pass it down for the many years that slavery and enslaved people were in chains, that becomes an instinct with them, and it is in sync with them. Where do we read about that cruelty in the scriptures? It starts with the letter P: perpetual hatred. You cannot change them. The scripture says, can a leopard change its spots? No. Esau will never change.

“and so long time dwelt he upon the earth with deceit.” They dwelt upon the earth with deceit, deceiving the whole world that the Most High and Christ and his angels and the twelve and the Jews are all white, when they are not.

“Hear this word that the Lord hath spoken against you, O children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up from the land of Egypt, saying.” Children of Israel — that is the topic, that has always been the subject matter. The whole family which he brought up from the land of Egypt.

“You only have I known of all the families of the earth.” You only have I known. Yeah, I created everybody, but you are a peculiar people. You are my chosen people. You are to be separate.

“therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.” Now I'm going to punish you, because I gave you my laws. I gave you my statutes. I gave you feast of tabernacles, Passover. I gave you Leviticus the eleventh chapter. I told you don't commit adultery. I gave you all these things and you still despised my laws. You ran into modern day Christianity. You run to Islam. You run to Buddhism. You run to all these different things — but not to me, your father. So because of that, I'm going to whip you, and I'm going to use the other nations who hate you to reign over you. That's what's going on.

So here's a sequence of events. You have election. You have law. You have disobedience. You have punishment, which is captivity. That's what's going on, and the Most High is using those who hate us to rule over us.

“If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you.” So what do you think Christ was teaching? Christ was teaching the same thing. There's no difference from what Christ taught. No, we are not deviating from the gospel. You just have not known the gospel. You have known Christianity. You learned white man lies.

That's why he told the Greek woman what he called her — a dog. He said it is not meat to take the children's bread and cast it to dogs. These blessings are not for you.

“If ye were of the world, the world would love his own: but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.” So God is telling us, Christ is telling us, that we are hated, and the reason is that he has chosen us out of the world.

Because Christ was the ultimate black revolutionary. He had a revolutionary spirit, and the same thing we teach is the exact same thing Christ taught. That's why he was put on the cross. You had the Pharisees that couldn't stand him, and they put him to death.

precepts.why:
“Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name’s sake.” We shall be hated of all nations. This is talking about the tatamites and coons, and it's also going into Esau.

For whose name's sake? For my name's sake. Because they know that Christ is in us. They know that Christ is black. If they hate Christ, they hate us. If they hate us, they hate Christ. There's no way around it.

And it is not just Esau. The white man's own memorandum on the Igbo Jews, read on the screen, calls them the wandering Jews of West Africa: gifted, aggressive, westernized, at best envied and resented, but mostly despised by their neighbours in the federation. So the white man knows who they are. Why are we envied? Because God's laws was only given to the Israelites. And that despising is the Hamites — the Hamites hated us as well, not just Esau.

Unfortunately, and fortunately, because prophecy has to be fulfilled, our brothers and sisters in the world are finding out the hard way. They're coming up missing. They're being hung from trees. They're being thrown in the water and they say, oh, he drowned — but there was no water in his lungs, nor a stomach. That's what happens when you're a hated people.

sense.text:
“I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence.” That's the point right there. The Most High said he's going to go and return to his place. When did that happen? 70 AD. And when else did God turn his back on us? The transatlantic and sub-Saharan slave trade — when we was in slavery, the Most High turned his back on us.

“till they acknowledge their offence.” Until we acknowledge our offence. How do we do that? By bethinking yourself and going through the process of repenting daily. That's how you acknowledge your offence. But in order to do that, our brothers and sisters in the world outside of this truth have to know what laws they're breaking, and the Christian church is not teaching no laws. That's why our brothers and sisters are confused. When the Bible says don't celebrate Christmas, keep Hanukkah, they're confused. They never heard of a Hanukkah. They never heard of a feast of dedication. So it's our job to tell them.

“and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early.” Seek God's face in the Bible. When we're catching hell on earth, and we realize that we are hated and in hell, that's when we're going to seek God's face in their affliction, and they will seek me early.

That's why these things are going on, and sometimes we have to just wholeheartedly accept it. The Most High has to bend our brothers and sisters to his will. He got to put boot to ass for people to wake up. That's the only way. There's no other way. So a lot of our people have to be an example. God is going to bend you to his will; he's going to show you that this man is the devil. Look how Nolan Wells had to learn the hard way — the only Jake on a boat full of red pasty milky Edomite devils. And I know some of us get upset, because I'm very upset about this case, but I understand why the Most High is doing what he's doing.

“Cursed be he that confirmeth not all the words of this law to do them. And all the people shall say, Amen.” And all the people shall say — all of our forefathers that came up out of Egypt shall say, Amen.

We said, Amen. We agreed to the covenant. We agreed to all the things that were written.

“But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day; that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee.”

Verses 1 to 14 are the blessings that we agreed to: if we keep God's laws, we're going to receive blessings. If we break God's laws, verses 15 to 68, we would be cursed as a nation of people. So the Most High is basically saying he's going to rain terror on our behinds if we don't apply his laws. We're going to be cursed as a people.

So how bad did our condition get when God turned his back on us? We're going to read it.

“And the anger of the Lord was hot against Israel.” The Most High was hot. He went from zero to a hundred real quick. That's how you know he's black. Look at the talk, look at the vernacular that they use in the Bible. Only black folks speak like this. The Most High said he was hot.

“and he delivered them into the hands of spoilers that spoiled them.” He delivered us unto the hand of the spoilers, which are the nations. How were we spoiled? When they give us things like welfare, WIC, the education that they give us — and religion. Religion was one of the main things, and politics was one of the main things, that spoiled us.

“and he sold them into the hands of their enemies round about.” God said he sold us into the hands of our enemies round about, meaning all over. Round about is a circle. So we were scattered throughout this whole globe where our enemies are, not just in America but everywhere. Wherever you find the Negroes at, you will find enemies. Even in Africa you'll find Hamite enemies. Europe, Edomite enemies. Japan, Ammonite enemies. China, Moabite enemies. In the lands where Ishmael is at, Ishmaelite enemies, Arab enemies. We are surrounded by our enemies.

“so that they could not any longer stand before their enemies.” And we can't stand before our enemies, because we lack military and economical might. The only thing we could rely on is spiritual might. You might be able to throw some hands one on one with an Edomite, break his jaw, stomp him out, but as far as war globally, nationally, hell no. We would get wiped out. So we don't want thoughts like that in your minds. You pick up a gun, where you going to get the bullets from? You pick up a gun, he come with a gatling gun, he come with a machine gun. Oh, you got a switch on your gun, you think it's a machine gun now? He come with a bazooka. He come with a drone — he don't even got to come out of his house. Now what do you got to say, Tyrone? We must rely on the Most High, our power in Christ.

precepts.why:
“Beware lest any man spoil you” — any man here is the same people that Christ said would come in his name and deceive many. Who's the many that came in Christ's name? Christians. White Christians. Edomite Christians. By way of Spain, by way of Portugal, by way of Italy, by way of France, by way of America, by way of Britain.

“through philosophy and vain deceit.” It's telling you how you're going to be spoiled: through philosophy and vain deceit. Lies, religious lies, which all of us came up out of. Now we have become Christian coons.

Religion was one of the main ways the Negro was spoiled. That's the spoiling of Judges 2:14: the anger of the Lord was hot, and he delivered us into the hands of spoilers that spoiled us.

sense.text:
“And thou shalt become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all nations whither the Lord shall lead thee.” So the Most High said we are going to be an astonishment, a proverb and a byword amongst all nations whither the Lord shall lead thee. An astonishment means people look at your condition in disbelief. A proverb is slick sayings — your suffering becomes an example. And a byword is being called outside your God-given name.

Not just here in America, but everywhere where the Lord shall lead thee. In Russia they call us baklazhan — that means an eggplant. In Italy they call us mulan, mulano, another word for eggplant. In Africa the Hamites call us a kata, cotton pickers. So it's not just America. It's everywhere.

Take a look at the Jim Crow museum. There was a small restaurant chain in the American West from the late 1920s through the 1950s whose entrances featured the head of a winking, grinning, grotesque caricature of a black man wearing a porter's cap, with the name written on the teeth framed by oversized red lips, and visitors entered through a doorway in the middle of the black man's mouth. The menu included southern fried chicken sandwiches and chicken pie, and black people, especially ones with very dark skin, were employed as the waiters, waitresses and cooks, to add injury to insult. See, Esau is just upset. The perpetual hatred is unreal. He's obsessed with us.

During the Jim Crow period a typical American kitchen had many products with images that portrayed black people in negative ways: packaging for cereal, syrup, pancake mix and detergent, salt and pepper shakers, string holders, cookbooks, hand towels, place mats, grocery list reminders and wall hangings. Any object found in a kitchen could be, and often was, transformed into anti-black propaganda. So they made sure that Edomite constituents knew that we were a mockery. They put it on every single thing you could probably see in a grocery store. It was making fun of us. We were proverbs and bywords.

The lawn jockey is a decorative yard ornament that caricatures black people and promotes the idea of their servitude, depicting a black man in jockey's clothing with exaggerated features such as bulging eyes, large red lips, a flat nose and curly hair, and both styles were still manufactured in 2012. Then there are the dolls, the games and the toys, and the cartoons that many of these senior citizens were around for and grew up on. They made sure they embedded in the minds of these people the racism and the hatred. That's why the first video showed the Edomite woman saying that thing is in their DNA and is passed down. They cannot get rid of it. And Aunt Jemima is a mockery at God, because Jemima was Job's daughter. The Most High is going to rip their tongue out of their mouth for that. The Most High is going to kill all of them for that. It's called truthful mock when Esau does that.

Then you have the list of anti-black slurs. Abeed is what the Arabs call us, which means slaves. Acting white. Alligator bait. Many of our forefathers were called cushy, which just means black — but we don't come from Cush, because Cush is a Hamite. Diversity, equity, inclusion: all of these are little words, code words, that they say amongst themselves. Just like when you're in an elevator with a whole bunch of them and they're going, damn, I hate Mondays, I hate Mondays, Bill, you hate Mondays too — how about you, Tyrone? And you say, man, I didn't want to come back to work today, I hate Mondays also. And they just giggle amongst themselves. They're talking about you. Monday is a byword. So the Most High meant what he said: that we shall become proverbs and bywords amongst all nations.

If you ever get the chance, visit these places. Do an outing with the body and travel to them. Show the children these are not things only of yesterday. They are today, and they will be things of the future. Just like America says never forget, we say never forget. Don't try to tell your kids to go to the bedroom — they need to see this. Let your eyes process what the hell you're seeing.

precepts.why:
“To make their land desolate, and a perpetual hissing.” So we're a perpetual hissing.

“every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished.” Every nation that passeth thereby shall be astonished. Why shall they be astonished? Because we are an astonishment.

“and wag his head.” And wag his head. They shake their head, like, these are the people of God? That's called wagging their head. Look at the human zoos — that is an astonishment. It happened here, it happened to our brothers, the tribe of Nephtali in the Pacific Islands, it happened to us all over the place, round about us, meaning the whole globe.

“Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.” So God made us a reproach to our neighbours.

“Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.” A byword among the heathen. A shaking of the head amongst the people. The same astonishment, proverb and byword that Moses wrote down.

“And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen.” God said he's going to leave our name for a curse unto his chosen.

“for the Lord God shall slay thee, and call his servants by another name.” Call his servants by another name. What is that other name? American. Black. Negro. Coon. Hispanic, Latin, Latina, Latino, Puerto Rican, Cuban. That's nowhere in the Bible. In the book of Hosea it tells you that in the place where it was said, ye are not my people, there it shall be said, ye are the children of the living God. Because in those places we're being called Pacific Islanders, we're being called Papua New Guineans, Ghanaians, Nigerians, black Americans, Haitians, Puerto Ricans and so forth.

But now the Most High woke us up, through our leadership, the bishops and deacons, to go out, teach our people and show them their nationality according to the Bible, and show them why these curses happened to our people: because we broke the commandments of the heavenly father.

sense.text:
“The fruit of thy land, and all thy labours, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up.” Now, this is more than just papaya, cassava, banana, fruits and vegetables. This is going into our resources that are in those various places, whether it be oil, diamond, gold, uranium, titanium. This is what the Most High is making reference to.

“and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway.” Now, is that for a dispensation of time? Alway means always. That's where we see the stupidity going on over there on the continent of Africa with these stupid contracts, these stupid deals that our brothers and sisters are making, like the latest one with the Congo — just giving away your resources.

Here's a prime example of what's going on. There was a potential coup in Haiti in 1981, 82, under the reign of Papa Doc and Baby Doc Duvalier: the Vatican, the CIA and Mobil Oil wanted to go in and remove the president, and they were going to invade through the Dominican Republic next door, until a CIA operative sent word that they were pulling the plug on the deal because the State Department thought it would be too controversial. He had already recruited an army of about 250 mercenaries — French Foreign Legion, American, Israeli — and the number one real military guy was a West Point graduate and professional mercenary whose claim to fame was that he was the last head of the Rhodesian cavalry, with a picture of him riding on a horse with a bayonet and a black baby on the bayonet. And they acquired a nuclear device for a million bucks from the French. They originally were going to nuke everything, but then they found out that ruins everything for twenty, thirty, fifty years, so then it had to be boots on the ground. They never carried out the plot, because Papa Doc and Baby Doc were never overthrown.

Notice the names that he mentioned who was supposed to take part in this wicked plot. He said the CIA, and he said the Vatican. That's what your Jesuits are for. That's what these priests are for, outside of being straight homosexual perverts. They're there to spy out the land. That's what they did in Papua New Guinea; that's how they destroyed them. They sent Jesuits, they sent priests, missionaries. That's how they win you over: they come with the Bible in one hand, but they got the sword in another. That's why a lot of people today say that although Papa Doc ruled Haiti with a rod of iron, Papa Doc and Baby Doc were the best presidents — they were infuriating America because they didn't want to play ball. Look at all these secret plots. This is a beautiful thing right here, because the Most High is allowing them to tell on themselves.

“Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things: and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.”

One word: domination. Dominated us in every aspect. Service, hunger, thirst, nakedness, deprivation, and a yoke of iron on our necks. They dominated us. Why? Because of that perpetual hatred, and because we broke God's commandments.

precepts.why:
Nehemiah is praying on the behalf of Israel. “Howbeit thou art just in all that is brought upon us; for thou hast done right, but we have done wickedly.” He said, God, you are just for all the evils that you brought upon us, because we're wicked as hell.

“Neither have our kings, our princes, our priests, nor our fathers, kept thy law, nor hearkened unto thy commandments and thy testimonies.” We didn't keep his law. “For they have not served thee in their kingdom, and in thy great goodness that thou gavest them, and in the large and fat land which thou gavest before them, neither turned they from their wicked works.” We started going into things like Molech, Chemosh and all these other gods. We had just seen what the Most High did in Egypt — we read about it, we heard about it — and we still forsook the Most High and went to all these Hamite and Canaanite deities.

“Behold, we are servants this day, and for the land that thou gavest unto our fathers to eat the fruit thereof and the good thereof, behold, we are servants in it.” We are servants in it. Even over here, because this land right here was given to Gad. The promised land was given to Gad. But there's a flip side of it: Esau was going to take this place violently away from Gad.

“And it yieldeth much increase unto the kings whom thou hast set over us because of our sins: also they have dominion over our bodies, and over our cattle, at their pleasure, and we are in great distress.” They have dominion. They dominated us. Power over our bodies — the same thing we read in Deuteronomy 28:48: service, hunger, thirst, nakedness and the yoke of iron. And we are in great distress.

sense.text:
“Cursed shalt thou be when thou comest in, and cursed shalt thou be when thou goest out.” When you are born, you're cursed. And even upon death, because they have control over our bodies.

That's what many of these unreasonable C-sections are for: to weaken the woman's body so she can't produce children or hold children. That's what's going on. There's so much evil going on in the medical field that we don't know about.

“And the Lord shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other.”

“and there thou shalt serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known, even wood and stone.” Christianity and Islam and everything else. Even wood and stone. Those two are the most bloodiest religions and the most dominant religions that our people struggle with: Christianity and Islam.

precepts.why:
“And I will scatter you among the heathen, and will draw out a sword after you: and your land shall be desolate, and your cities waste.”

The same scattering: among the heathen, with a sword drawn out after us, our land desolate and our cities waste.

sense.text:
“Therefore the fathers shall eat the sons in the midst of thee, and the sons shall eat their fathers.” So what was Ezekiel prophesying, and during what reign? Babylon was ruling. So this happened during the time of Babylon. And when was another time we were forced into cannibalism? 70 AD, Rome. So you have Babylon, then you have Rome.

“and I will execute judgments in thee.” You hear that? I will execute judgment in thee. The Most High's wrath was angered. He was hot against us. So he caused these things to happen to us by allowing Nebuchadnezzar and them to cut off the food supply, the importing of food, the exporting of food. All of that ceased. The water ceased. Food ceased. So now we started to look at each other like, damn, his arm looked pretty good — and then we started to eat each other, some eating our own kids or your neighbour's kids. That's what happened.

The reason this is read too is because these pathetics like to say, well, when did that happen to you so-called Negroes on this side? Write this down so you're not confused: Portuguese slave ship, 1837. The captain and crew forced slaves to eat another slave. The slave's name was Mina, M-I-N-A, while the Edomite ate his heart and liver. The British royal vessel HMS Snake captured the Arrogante off the coast of Cuba and brought the ship to Jamaica, where they heard all the atrocities that were happening on the boat from the other blacks that were on the boat, the slaves, who told them what had happened. And there's a book called The Delectable Negro that accounts how white people consumed us and how we were forced to consume each other on many plantations and slave ships during our forced migration to the Americas. So yes, we do fulfil Deuteronomy 28. Nobody should be confounded by any apologist pathetics, with all the access to books and research to do your own research.

“And he shall besiege thee in all thy gates, until thy high and fenced walls come down, wherein thou trustedst, throughout all thy land: and he shall besiege thee in all thy gates throughout all thy land, which the Lord thy God hath given thee.” That's the white man. Rome. And what happened to Rome happened again in the Americas.

“And thou shalt eat the fruit of thine own body, the flesh of thy sons and of thy daughters, which the Lord thy God hath given thee, in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee.” You hear that? You shall eat the fruit of your own body.

And it also happened during the Liberian War. There are documents on it where brothers were digging up people from the grave and eating dead bodies, because of the shortage of food supply. That happened to us on many occasions.

When you're talking to these people, you've got to realize they got their filthy hands on our Constitution. They don't got no damn power over you. They shouldn't even be able to utter the words of this Bible. Shut their mouths with the Bible and with history. Nobody should be getting confounded or confused. Absolutely not.

“And among these nations shalt thou find no ease, neither shall the sole of thy foot have rest.” You hear that? Even the sole of your foot shall not have rest.

So it was recorded in Deuteronomy. Deuteronomy predicted it would happen. We are not in our land of rest.

precepts.why:
Jeremiah says the same thing. What was he lamenting about? “Judah is gone into captivity because of affliction, and because of great servitude: she dwelleth among the heathen, she findeth no rest.”

She findeth no rest — wherever Judah is at, and all the other tribes, not just Judah. So this prophecy was, and is currently still being, fulfilled.

sense.text:
“And the Lord shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships, by the way whereof I spake unto thee, Thou shalt see it no more again.” You're not going to see your homeland as a nation of people ever again — till Christ return.

“and there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, and no man shall buy you.” Mississippi, Kentucky, Texas, New York. For bondmen and bondwomen. And no man shall buy you — no man shall redeem you.

precepts.why:
“I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat, and will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations, and parted my land.” So we were scattered, and they parted God's land. So we got Palestine, and you have the Amalekites, the Israelis, over there.

“And they have cast lots for my people.” He cast lots for us. We were sold. “and have given a boy for an harlot, and sold a girl for wine, that they might drink.” They turned the boys into breeders, and the girls were made whores, sold for wine, that they might drink. We see that in a lot of these different movies with the white men sleeping with the sisters for fun.

sense.text:
“Therefore my people are gone into captivity, because they have no knowledge.” That knowledge is the laws of God.

“and their honourable men are famished, and their multitude dried up with thirst.” And our people are thirsty. Why? The water that they lack is the water of God, the word of God.

“Therefore hell hath enlarged herself, and opened her mouth without measure.” Therefore hell means everything that Isaiah just stated in verse 13 — therefore captivity. Hell hath enlarged herself and opened her mouth without measure.

Brothers, we are hated and we are in hell. Severe affliction, captivity, slavery and confinement — that's the particular hell being spoken of. That's the state of the black man in America and abroad, to where they could just cut off the electricity and the oil flowing into Cuba just like that, by the snap of a finger. That's why they have dominion over our bodies.

“and their glory, and their multitude, and their pomp, and he that rejoiceth, shall descend into it.”

precepts.why:
Hell is also confinement. Not only is it affliction, captivity and slavery, but it's also confinement. That is hell.

“Then Jonah prayed unto the Lord his God out of the fish’s belly, And said, I cried by reason of mine affliction unto the Lord, and he heard me.” So he cried for his affliction. What was the affliction? Him being swallowed up in the fish's belly.

“out of the belly of hell cried I.” Out of the belly of hell. That was confinement. That was Jonah's small little captivity hell that he was going through: confinement inside the whale's belly.

“The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me. In my distress I called upon the Lord, and cried unto my God.”

So that hell he's talking about was sorrow.

“For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his dwelling place.” For they — the other nations — have devoured Jacob, the Israelites, and laid waste his dwelling place.

“O remember not against us former iniquities: let thy tender mercies speedily prevent us: for we are brought very low.” So being brought down to a very low estate is also hell.

sense.text:
“Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.” Though thou hast sore broken us — the us here is the Israelites. In the place of dragons: who's that? Esau. Greece, Rome, Spain, France, Germany, Russia, Great Britain and America.

And covered us with what? Captivity. The shadow of death.

“If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god; Shall not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.” Which we did — all these different religions.

So he's not going to punish us for all this wickedness that we did? Of course he is. For he knoweth the secrets of the heart.

“Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.” That's what we see going on in the media still, October 2026. Some of us would never have imagined that we would turn on the news and see a whole bunch of people being lynched, black bodies being found hanging from a tree — and they call it suicide. We thought that was something of the 1930s, 40s, 50s, 60s. Nope. Still going on today. Why? Because Esau is still here today.

“Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? arise, cast us not off for ever.” Wake up, Jacob. Wake up out of these religions. Wake up out of sin.

The Lord is sleeping right now. He's only going to awake when you awake. That's what the Bible says: awake ye to righteousness. The Lord is only going to awake when we awake. Right now Jacob is sleeping.

“Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and forgettest our affliction and our oppression? For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto the earth.” He's hiding his face from us. That's why we got to seek his face.

“Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies’ sake.” And redeem us for thy mercies' sake, meaning the oath that he made to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. Not because of anything special that we're doing. Absolutely not.

“But this is a people robbed and spoiled.” Israel, we are robbed and spoiled.

“they are all of them snared in holes.” They are all — not some. It says all of us are snared in holes.

“and they are hid in prison houses: they are for a prey, and none delivereth; for a spoil, and none saith, Restore.” They're hid in prison houses. We are for a prey. And none delivereth. For a spoil, and none saith, Restore.

So we have robbed, spoiled, prisoner, prey, and no deliverer, all in one verse.

precepts.why:
Let's deal with the robbed. “The fruit of thy land, and all thy labours, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up; and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway.” We read this already, but we're going to read it again.

One nation in particular: Papua New Guinea. The tribe of Nephtali and the tribe of Benjamin in Papua New Guinea export 98% of their resources to Australia and Britain. Then they have to re-import it and be paid interest upon their import. That right there is what's called being dominated. That's what's called being robbed and spoiled.

We already know about Africa, but how about the other places where our people are at? We are spoiled. Robbed all over.

Now for the spoiled part, because we were spoiled in philosophies and religions. “How canst thou say, I am not polluted, I have not gone after Baalim?” This is us going into other religions, also known as idols.

“see thy way in the valley, know what thou hast done: thou art a swift dromedary traversing her ways.” Thou art a what? A swift dromedary. That's a camel in heat. That is a female camel in heat running to the first one that she sees. God is comparing us like that because we strayed away from his laws. We gave up our true religion, which is this constitution called the Bible, and now we're in Christianity, Islam and all these different funky denominations. We've become a dromedary. We became a female camel in heat, running to the first ride.

“A wild ass used to the wilderness, that snuffeth up the wind at her pleasure.” Then he turns back and calls us a wild ass used to the wilderness. That's what we've become. We snuff up every wind at her pleasure.

“in her occasion who can turn her away? all they that seek her will not weary themselves; in her month they shall find her.” All they that seek to destroy us — all these that set up these religions — they don't seek us. We go to them. In her month they shall find her. Why? Because we're going to seek them. Because we're hot right now. We're in heat. We're in heat to do wickedly. That's what Jeremiah is saying here. When we got the one true God, we got the one true power, none of our brothers and sisters should still be in that foolishness called Christianity or Islam.

“For I know that after my death ye will utterly corrupt yourselves.” Moses said, I know after I die, Israel, you will utterly corrupt yourselves. We have utterly corrupted ourselves until this day.

“and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will befall you in the latter days.”

So we corrupted ourselves with idolatry, with different religions. We're not only robbed — we spoiled ourselves in these different religions.

“To open the blind eyes, to bring out the prisoners from the prison, and them that sit in darkness out of the prison house.”

Isaiah 42:22 says we are robbed and spoiled, but also prisoners. So we are the ones in the prison houses. We are the ones in darkness.

“Those are the ten tribes, which were carried away prisoners out of their own land.” Which are carried away what? Prisoners. We were carried away prisoners. That's always been our reputation.

Why were we slaves? Because we broke God's commandments. So God used those who hate us to enslave us, to chastise us.

“For when unrighteous men thought to oppress the holy nation; they being shut up in their houses, the prisoners of darkness, and fettered with the bonds of a long night, lay there exiled from the eternal providence.” The prisoners of darkness. So that's been us this whole time.

And that goes into the migration of Israel, during the time of Cyrus, when a bulk of the northern kingdom came to this part of the world, and also the Pacific Islands and other places.

“I will send him against an hypocritical nation, and against the people of my wrath will I give him a charge.” Yes, this is talking about Assyria, but it's going into our oppressors.

“To take the spoil, and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.” And to take the prey. And we were trodden down. We were tread down. We're still being stomped on in this very day. Yes, we are hated until this very day.

“There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof, like a roaring lion ravening the prey.” Ravening the prey. Who's the prey? The Israelites. The ones destitute of knowledge, who depend on these pastors and priests to show them who they are according to the Bible and what they have done wrong to cause that breach between themselves and the Most High.

This is going into the coons, because it's not just other nations that hate us. We have some of our own skin folk, I would call them, that hate our guts too, that hate black people — especially some of these no good damn pastors. “they have devoured souls; they have taken the treasure and precious things; they have made her many widows in the midst thereof.”

“Her priests have violated my law, and have profaned mine holy things: they have put no difference between the holy and profane, neither have they shewed difference between the unclean and the clean, and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.” They violated God's laws, and the Most High said he's profaned amongst them.

So these are the ways that we've become a prey. It's natural to be a prey to the other nations, because we know they hate our guts. That's why God created them: to be his whipping belt on the earth. But our own should not be. And hopefully these priests and pastors who are watching these various classes come to repentance.

Still dealing with the prayer. “And for our sins and our fathers’ we with our brethren and our kings and our priests were given up unto the kings of the earth, to the sword, and to captivity, and for a prey with shame, unto this day.”

And for a prey with shame. Unto this day. Until this day. Until this very day.

sense.text: “I am the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.” Because Jeremiah seen what happened. Although he was not taken into captivity with Babylon, he seen the affliction of our people.
“He hath led me, and brought me into darkness, but not into light.” That's that hell. That's that captivity. He's seen it.

“Surely against me is he turned; he turneth his hand against me all the day. My flesh and my skin hath he made old; he hath broken my bones. He hath builded against me, and compassed me with gall and travail.” Affliction.

“He hath set me in dark places, as they that be dead of old.” Captivity.

So this is Jeremiah just explaining the conditions of his people, the hell that they were catching.

So why was Israel suffering? Because we broke God's commandments. Now we got to ask: does God therefore excuse the nations who have done these things to us? Are they excused? Absolutely not. Hell to the no.

“Therefore fear thou not, O my servant Jacob, saith the Lord; neither be dismayed, O Israel.” Don't be dismayed, O Israel. “for, lo, I will save thee from afar, and thy seed from the land of their captivity.” God said he's going to save us from afar — America and the various places where we were sold as slaves.

“and Jacob shall return, and shall be in rest, and be quiet, and none shall make him afraid.” We're going to return back to God, because we backslided away from him. And we shall be in rest: a thousand years with Christ.

“For I am with thee, saith the Lord, to save thee.” To save thee. He's the deliverer.

“though I make a full end of all nations whither I have scattered thee, yet will I not make a full end of thee.” Bye-bye, Elam. Bye-bye, Moab. Bye-bye, Esau. But not a full end of us.

“but I will correct thee in measure, and will not leave thee altogether unpunished.” So that's the one third.
“For thus saith the Lord, Thy bruise is incurable, and thy wound is grievous. There is none to plead thy cause, that thou mayest be bound up: thou hast no healing medicines.”

“All thy lovers have forgotten thee; they seek thee not; for I have wounded thee with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the multitude of thine iniquity; because thy sins were increased.” The lovers here is going into the other nations that we depended on, that we looked up to — just like back then, during the time of Isaiah and Jeremiah, we always looked up to Egypt, to Assyria, looking for help. Help from our enemies, and they cannot help us.

Just like this situation with Nolan Wells. Jacob is thinking the district attorney, the devil's assistant, is going to bring forth justice, because they say in law you can indict a ham sandwich. The jury didn't bring no indictment although they seen all the evidence. Oh no, we don't see any evidence of foul play. And Jacob is going crazy, because he is depending on this Edomite dog devil to bring forth truth.

Because of our sins were increased. That's why we're in hell.

“Why criest thou for thine affliction? thy sorrow is incurable for the multitude of thine iniquity: because thy sins were increased, I have done these things unto thee.” Why you crying, Jacob? Why you crying? You American blacks, you Caribbean blacks, you Haitian blacks, why are you crying for?

You crying, but you still on Sunday running to the Seventh-day Adventist church. You still going to celebrate Christmas — I told you not to celebrate Christmas, and two months from now you going to celebrate it. Even some of you online who might have one foot in, one foot out. Thanksgiving, you going to make an excuse to go to your auntie's house to eat some of that turkey, get some of that cranberry sauce, that stuffing. You still going to make your way down to Times Square New Year's Eve. Why you crying for when you get hit with a stray bullet, or when they find Tyrone hanging from a tree?

I have done these things unto thee. That's why in the Apocrypha it says to sin less. We've done these things, but God is asking us to sin less.

“Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured.” Although you did all these things, and I put you in the hellish condition that you're in, you can still repent. All those that devour thee shall be destroyed.

“and all thine adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity.” Every single last one of them. They're not escaping. All of them shall go into captivity.

“and they that spoil thee shall be a spoil, and all that prey upon thee will I give for a prey.” He's going to give them for a prey.

precepts.why:
“And it shall come to pass, that as ye were a curse among the heathen, O house of Judah, and house of Israel; so will I save you, and ye shall be a blessing: fear not, but let your hands be strong.”

“For thus saith the Lord of hosts; As I thought to punish you, when your fathers provoked me to wrath, saith the Lord of hosts, and I repented not.” And I repented not. And I change not.

“So again have I thought in these days to do well unto Jerusalem and to the house of Judah: fear ye not.” Fear ye not. Don't fear.

“For the Lord will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land.” That's what the Bible's all about. The Lord will have mercy on Jacob only, meaning the Israelites. And will only choose Israel. And set us in our own land, Jerusalem — that whole eastern hemisphere. The whole planet earth is going to be ours; Jerusalem is where the capital is going to be.

“and the strangers shall be joined with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob. And the people shall take them, and bring them to their place: and the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of the Lord for servants and handmaids.” And the other nations are going to be joined with us as slaves. I like to use the word slaves. I don't want to use servants — servants sounds too nice. Slaves. And we're going to break them to follow God's laws.

“and they shall take them captives, whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors. And it shall come to pass in the day that the Lord shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve.” Shall give us rest. That's that thousand-year rulership under Christ. Rest from the hell that we caught.

So are we hated? Are we in hell? But the only difference is we can come up out of that. That hell is only for a dispensation of time until Christ comes. And those of us who are saved in that day are going to inherit eternal life under Christ. There will be no more hell.

sense.text:
So you have two different groups of people that are hated and in hell. Our hell, we could redeem ourselves — we got a chance to repent. Now let's read about our long-lost brother. Let's go to the beginning.

“And Isaac intreated the Lord for his wife, because she was barren: and the Lord was intreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.” So Rebekah could not have children. She went to the Most High and prayed for kids.

“And the children struggled together within her.” The children — not child, the children — which means twins.

“and she said, If it be so, why am I thus? And she went to enquire of the Lord.” If this is from you, Lord, and it's a blessing, why do I have stomach pains?

“And the Lord said unto her, Two nations are in thy womb.” Two nations. That's why it's written in the book of Genesis, the beginning of nations. Two nations, separate people.

“and two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels; and the one people shall be stronger than the other people.” More power than the other, meaning more spiritual power, and physical power.

“and the elder shall serve the younger.” The first child that comes out is destined to be a servant, a slave, to the younger child.

“And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb. And the first came out red, all over like an hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.” And they called his name Esau, which was later changed to Edom.

What happened to us during the time of Babylon, when Babylon came in with Nebuchadnezzar to destroy us? Did he have cheerleaders? Did he have counterparts who helped him? Absolutely yes. And one of those nations was Esau.

“Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.” Rase it — R-A-S-E. Not raise it, not R-A-I-S-E. Rase it, meaning destroy it, like when you erase something, destroy it. Destroy Israel. That's what they was cheering.

And even is written in italics, meaning indeed: destroy it to the very foundation. Don't leave a crumb. Don't leave nothing. Don't leave any remembrance of them. Destroy them. That's what they was cheering with the Babylonians.

“O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed.” O daughter of who? O daughter of Babylon.

Future prophecy is that the daughter of Babylon, Edom, will be destroyed.

Jeremiah wrote about this too. When Babylon came into the land, they were cheering and hoping and thankful for our demise. Why? Because they wanted their land. They always wanted the land. Until this very day.

“Because of the mountain of Zion, which is desolate, the foxes walk upon it.” What is Jeremiah saying here? Nobody should be confused by the words he's using. Why was it desolate, and by who?

Because of the mountain of Zion which is desolate, the foxes walk upon it. Who are the foxes? Edom. Edom are the foxes, meaning a base person, a usurper.

precepts.why:
Let's see what Christ said — the black Messiah, by the way, for those of you who are just tuning in online. Jeremiah said mount Zion is desolate and foxes walk upon it; Christ said the same thing in Luke 21, when he said Jerusalem, you shall be carried away captive, and the Gentiles shall tread down Jerusalem until the time of the Gentiles be fulfilled. But watch this.

“The same day there came certain of the Pharisees, saying unto him, Get thee out, and depart hence: for Herod will kill thee.” That's the coons, that's the tatamites of that day.

“And he said unto them, Go ye, and tell that fox, Behold, I cast out devils, and I do cures to day and to morrow, and the third day I shall be perfected.” Go ye and tell that who? That fox. And that fox he was making reference to was Herod. What was Herod's nationality? He was an Edomite.

Consider the following list of possibilities for fox in its negative sense: weakling, small fry, usurper, poser, clown, insignificant person as the dust of a balance or the water that falls from a vessel, cream puff, nobody, weasel, jackass, tin soldier, peon, hick, pompous pretender, jerk, upstart. A prideful pretender — that's why in the book of Isaiah it says your pomp shall be brought down to the ground.

So go back to Luke and replace the word fox here for pretender: go ye and tell that pretender. Go tell that pretender, that fake, that phony, that synagogue of Satan. Herod was considered like the president at that time, a so-called king. And how did Christ, the epitome of what a black revolutionary should be, respond? Did he tuck his tail and run and hide? Behold, I cast out devils, and I do cures to day and to morrow, and the third day I shall be perfected. That's the same sentiment we got to walk with in the spirit of Christ. That's a spirit of power right there.

Y'all forgot what Christ said. “I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich) and I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not.” I know the lies of them which say they are Jews and are not.

But what are they? Posers. Usurpers. Not the people of God. That's what Christ was calling that Edomite.

sense.text: “The burden of the word of the Lord to Israel by Malachi.”

“I have loved you, saith the Lord. Yet ye say, Wherein hast thou loved us? Was not Esau Jacob’s brother? saith the Lord: yet I loved Jacob.” Yet I loved Israel. Yes, I love these Negroes who the world hates. I loved you.

“And I hated Esau, and laid his mountains and his heritage waste for the dragons of the wilderness.” And I hated Esau. So you have another group of people who is hated.

But it's one thing to be hated by men, and it is another thing to be hated by God. You don't want to be hated by God. Fortunately for us, we're not hated by God. We can repent of our sins, as the Israelites.

And laid his mountains and his heritage waste for the dragons of the wilderness — that's joining the dark ages. 193 AD is the start of the dark ages.

“Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places.” That's the pomp that allows him to say that. The pride, the power that the devil gave him, allows him to walk with such pride.

“thus saith the Lord of hosts, They shall build, but I will throw down; and they shall call them, The border of wickedness.” No, they shall call him Esau. And they shall call them — plural, all of them, every single last one, man, woman and child. Border is the beginning, the start, the pioneer.

“and, The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever.” And the people — plural. Against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever. Not for a dispensation of time. For ever. Oh, we could include them? For ever. That's to you apologists. The Bible says for ever. I don't care how many podcasts you go on, what you try to put out there, whatever doctrine y'all try to spin up, you cannot change God's mind.

precepts.why:
Let's see what he said in Romans, New Testament. “And not only this; but when Rebecca also had conceived by one, even by our father Isaac; (For the children being not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calleth.” The purpose of God according to election. So God was the one behind us choosing. He elected us. All praises to the Most High for that. Not of works, but of him that calleth.

“It was said unto her, The elder shall serve the younger.” Shall serve — future prophecy. It will happen. Although it tarry, wait for it. The elder shall serve the younger.

“As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.” As it is written — the same thing Malachi wrote. And it's a horrible thing to be hated by God. I'd rather be hated by men than hated by God.

sense.text:
“The vision of Obadiah. Thus saith the Lord God concerning Edom.” Concerning who? Concerning Edom. Replace that word there and put Caucasians — European Caucasians. The so-called Europeans are Edom. We're going to make it crystal clear, because some of you like the word Edom instead; it makes you feel comfortable. Well, now we're going to make you uncomfortable. Put the man in his proper category: thus saith the Lord God concerning European Caucasians. Let that thing sink through. Don't try to cut no corners. A tatamite right now is online and they are catching seizures at home from that.

“We have heard a rumour from the Lord, and an ambassador is sent among the heathen, Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle.”

“Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen: thou art greatly despised.” I made you small amongst the heathen.

Thou art greatly despised — not only of God, when he said, I hated Esau, but the other nations too. That's why they called this place great Satan. This is a place that drops bombs. This is a place that robs, spoils, kills, murders.

“The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee.” Because you are pompous, you usurper, the pride of your heart has deceived you.

“thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high.” That's where the word Caucasian comes from: cave dweller. And back during the time of the ancient Israelites, when he pushed the Horites out of the mountains, he took that spot too, because he always loved the cave. The word Horite means cave dweller. He wanted to be the cave dweller. He had to fulfil prophecy, and God said, okay, you're going to do it, you're going to fulfil this prophecy.

“that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?” How was he able to say such things? Who shall bring me down to the ground? Because in the book of Ecclesiastes, remember what it says: power was on their side. They have military power to do that, to say, who shall bring me down to the ground? Nuclear power, hydrogen power, atom bomb type of power.

“Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle.” And that's always been his emblem. Not only America, but Britain, Spain, Portugal, France always use the eagle as an emblem, because the eagle is a bird of prey. They are predators, and we are the prey.

“and though thou set thy nest among the stars.” They're the only ones doing space travel. When they landed on the moon, they said, the eagle has landed.

“thence will I bring thee down, saith the Lord.” Then will I bring you down.

“If thieves came to thee, if robbers by night, (how art thou cut off!) would they not have stolen till they had enough? if the grapegatherers came to thee, would they not leave some grapes?”

Now, you break into somebody's house, you might take a DVD player, if people still use that. You might take the TV if it's small enough to carry. You might look for some cash, a little bit of jewellery. This man, he comes, he takes the sheetrock, the pipes out of the wall. You come there and all you find is a mound of dirt — then he comes back the following week and takes the dirt. That's Esau for you.

He has an insatiable appetite, and he displayed that all the way back in the time of Genesis when he said, feed me with that same red pottage of uncooked meat, I'm hungry, I want that now. That insatiable appetite from Genesis all the way till now.
“How are the things of Esau searched out! how are his hidden things sought up!”

“All the men of thy confederacy have brought thee even to the border: the men that were at peace with thee have deceived thee, and prevailed against thee.” That's NATO.

Notice what it says here: and prevailed against thee. Meaning God is going to make sure every last sentence here, every last jot or tittle over here in this book of the law, is going to be fulfilled. It says NATO is going to come up against thee, and he's going to prevail.

“they that eat thy bread have laid a wound under thee: there is none understanding in him.”

“Shall I not in that day, saith the Lord, even destroy the wise men out of Edom, and understanding out of the mount of Esau?” That's the Germans, the scientists, Amalek, all of them. He's going to clear it up right here.

“And thy mighty men, O Teman, shall be dismayed.” That's the Germans, the German Caucasians, because a lot of them were taken and came over here through Operation Paperclip, where they absorbed a lot of the Nazi scientists that was building stuff and brought them over here, and they started building all these bombs that we have today. Remember Einstein, Oppenheimer — that's all Amalekite Germans, the mighty men of Teman.

“to the end that every one of the mount of Esau may be cut off by slaughter.” And the Most High is looking forward to that thing. He's looking forward to that slaughter.

“For thy violence against thy brother Jacob shame shall cover thee, and thou shalt be cut off for ever.” For thy violence. Perpetual violence. That violence against thy brother Jacob. Shame shall cover thee, and thou shalt be cut off for ever.

“In the day that thou stoodest on the other side.” What is he talking about? When Babylon came up against us, they stood on the other side.

“in the day that the strangers carried away captive his forces, and foreigners entered into his gates, and cast lots upon Jerusalem, even thou wast as one of them.” Even thou wast as one of them. The same thing that happened back then happened unto this very day. Because you had Hamites and Arabs selling us to Esau. Then you had the Amalekites come in, and what did they do? They financed the slave trade. Many of them had humongous interest and stock in the East India Company and the West India Company, and they were in charge of the auction blocks. Many of those auctions didn't even happen on the Sabbath. That was them. That was Esau. Throw the rock and hide the hand. That's them. Amalek.

“But thou shouldest not have looked on the day of thy brother in the day that he became a stranger; neither shouldest thou have rejoiced over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction.” They rejoiced over that when Babylon came up against us.

“neither shouldest thou have spoken proudly in the day of distress.” And he spoke proudly. King David told us: he said, rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof. Spoke proudly.

“Thou shouldest not have entered into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity.” He couldn't wait to take the land.

“yea, thou shouldest not have looked on their affliction in the day of their calamity, nor have laid hands on their substance in the day of their calamity.”

“Neither shouldest thou have stood in the crossway, to cut off those of his that did escape.” So notice what Obadiah is telling you here. He's telling you that even the ones that escaped, that tried to escape Babylon, Edom helped capture us and bring us to Babylon, bring us to Nebuchadnezzar. They were like the bounty hunters, the slave catchers. That's what they were doing to us.

“neither shouldest thou have delivered up those of his that did remain in the day of distress.”

“For the day of the Lord is near upon all the heathen.” For the day of the Lord is near upon all the heathen.

“as thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee: thy reward shall return upon thine own head.” As thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee. Your reward shall return upon your own head. That's future prophecy right there.

“For as ye have drunk upon my holy mountain, so shall all the heathen drink continually, yea, they shall drink, and they shall swallow down.” You're going to swallow down all the dregs of that cup of wrath. That's what God is going into: judgment.

“and they shall be as though they had not been.”

“But upon mount Zion shall be deliverance.” But upon where? But upon mount Zion shall be deliverance. That's redeemed out of hell.

“and there shall be holiness; and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions.” We were hated, but we're going to get redeemed out of hell. Esau is hated, and he will not get redeemed from his hell.

“And the house of Jacob shall be a fire, and the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble.” The house of Esau for stubble. Baby stubble. Grandma stubble. Uncle stubble. Like Deacon Asaph said.

“and they shall kindle in them, and devour them.” We're going to devour them. We're going to eat. We're going to eat your food. Go ahead, take your resources — we're going to devour you. This is exactly what's going to happen.

“and there shall not be any remaining of the house of Esau; for the Lord hath spoken it.” There shall be none remaining of the house of Esau. For who hath spoken it? For the Lord hath spoken it.

precepts.why:
“Because thou hast said, These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it; whereas the Lord was there.”

It's the same thing they did back then. Obadiah is telling you they did that back then, and they also did that in this present time. These two countries, these two nations: you have the land of Israel, and America. And you also have Judah and Ephraim.

But remember, back then they did the same thing. When Babylon carried us away, they could not wait to inherit the land. He couldn't wait to take the land.

You sow what you reap. You reap what you sow. “Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.” God is not mocked.

Thy reward shall return upon thine own head. Whatever you sow, you reap. You sowed robbery, you sowed violence — you're going to reap the same thing. That's what the Most High is telling you.

sense.text:
“For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.” It shall come down upon Idumea — Edom, European Caucasians. Put European Caucasians in the place of Idumea: for my sword shall be bathed in heaven, behold, it shall come down upon European Caucasians, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.

Let's get some more people mad online. Now you see, now you catching on. The Christianity is leaving the brain now. He was afraid to say it, and now the Christianity is slowly seeping away. All praises.

“The sword of the Lord is filled with blood, it is made fat with fatness, and with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams: for the Lord hath a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Idumea.” A great slaughter in the land of European Caucasians.
“And the unicorns shall come down with them, and the bullocks with the bulls; and their land shall be soaked with blood, and their dust made fat with fatness.”

“For it is the day of the Lord’s vengeance, and the year of recompences for the controversy of Zion.” For it is the day of the Lord's vengeance.

And what is the controversy of Zion? Who are the Israelites? Is it the so-called European man in the land of Israel today? Who are they? That's the controversy of Zion.

“And the streams thereof shall be turned into pitch, and the dust thereof into brimstone, and the land thereof shall become burning pitch.” That burning pitch — that's that hell.

“It shall not be quenched night nor day.” It shall not be quenched. So their hell, it can't be quenched. Our hell can be quenched. Our hell could be quenched; their hell cannot be quenched. Night nor day.

“the smoke thereof shall go up for ever: from generation to generation it shall lie waste; none shall pass through it for ever and ever.” The smoke thereof shall go up for ever. Forever. Ever. Ever. Ever.

“Who is this that cometh from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah?” That's Christ that's coming from Edom.

“this that is glorious in his apparel, travelling in the greatness of his strength?” Because Christ is coming back with power.

“I that speak in righteousness, mighty to save.”

“Wherefore art thou red in thine apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winefat?” He's red because he's slaughtering the red man, and he got the red man's blood all over himself.

“I have trodden the winepress alone; and of the people there was none with me.” He's done it alone. He wants to show his power.

“for I will tread them in mine anger, and trample them in my fury; and their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments, and I will stain all my raiment.” He said he's going to stain all his raiment. Not just some parts of it. Not just the sleeves where he used his big black hands to strangle Esau, to rip his head off. No. All of it. He's going to be soaked in blood. That's a beautiful sight to behold.

“For the day of vengeance is in mine heart, and the year of my redeemed is come. And I looked, and there was none to help; and I wondered that there was none to uphold: therefore mine own arm brought salvation unto me; and my fury, it upheld me.”

“And I will tread down the people in mine anger, and make them drunk in my fury, and I will bring down their strength to the earth.” He's going to tread them down in his anger, for the controversy of Zion.

And I will bring down their strength to the earth. I'm going to bring down their strength to a low estate.

He is going to drink of that cup. The same hell we received, he's going to receive. His is worse. His is unforgiving, unquenchable.

“Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, that dwellest in the land of Uz.” This is the Most High being sarcastic.

“the cup also shall pass through unto thee: thou shalt be drunken, and shalt make thyself naked.” But laugh now, cry later. That's what the Most High is telling them. Rejoice — no, you're going to have fun. Smile while you drink that cup. That's what God is saying. And shalt make thyself naked: the punishment, the shame, your sin is going to be revealed.

“The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion; he will no more carry thee away into captivity.” O daughter of Zion, he will no more carry thee away into captivity.

“he will visit thine iniquity, O daughter of Edom; he will discover thy sins.” He will visit thine iniquity, O daughter of European Caucasians. He will discover thy sins.

Esau doesn't think this is going to happen, but it will happen.

“And thou saidst, I shall be a lady for ever: so that thou didst not lay these things to thy heart, neither didst remember the latter end of it.” Esau thinks their kingdom is going to go on for ever. That's what it's talking about right here when it says, I shall be a lady for ever. So that thou didst not lay these things to thy heart, neither didst remember the latter end of it.

“Therefore hear now this, thou that art given to pleasures.” Insatiable appetites.

“that dwellest carelessly, that sayest in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me.” I am what? I am Yahawah. I am God. That's what he says. And there's no others beside me.

“I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children.” I'm not going to mourn. I'm not going to lose anything. That's what they think. They're going to go on for ever. But they forgot: everything that goes up must come down.

“But these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood.” In a moment in one day. It's going to take God one hour to destroy over two hundred years of a flourishing nation. The loss of children, and widowhood. There shall be none remaining of the house of Esau.

“they shall come upon thee in their perfection for the multitude of thy sorceries, and for the great abundance of thine enchantments.”

“For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness: thou hast said, None seeth me.” So when they had us in slavery, they was destroying us and saying, none seeth me. Even these secret plots and these things that they do behind the scenes, they say, none seeth me — like the video with the dude that was talking about what they tried to do in Haiti in 1981. We weren't taught that in school. We didn't know about that. They tried to do those things secretly.

“Thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee.” That's their witchcraft. That's their science.

“and thou hast said in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me.”

“Therefore shall evil come upon thee; thou shalt not know from whence it riseth: and mischief shall fall upon thee; thou shalt not be able to put it off: and desolation shall come upon thee suddenly, which thou shalt not know.” That's that sudden destruction.

“And there came one of the seven angels which had the seven vials, and talked with me, saying unto me, Come hither; I will shew unto thee the judgment of the great whore.” The great whore is America.

“that sitteth upon many waters.” That sitteth upon many nations.

“With whom the kings of the earth have committed fornication.” All her allies committed fornication with her. In order to receive resources and benefits economically, they must lay in bed with this great whore called America.

“and the inhabitants of the earth have been made drunk with the wine of her fornication.” The wine of what? That wine is lies, philosophies. Drunk with the lies of her fornication.
