“And he cried mightily with a strong voice, saying, Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen.” It's fallen. America is fallen. It's fallen.

“and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird.”

precepts.why:
Where was John the Revelator getting this from? As it is written — the Old Testament. All the prophets spoke the same thing.

“And, behold, here cometh a chariot of men, with a couple of horsemen. And he answered and said, Babylon is fallen, is fallen.”

“and all the graven images of her gods he hath broken unto the ground.” And we have many gods here that we serve. Some we serve unknowingly, by wearing some of their apparel, like Nike and so forth, these different things that we wear. Everything is idolatry in this place. So the Most High said he's going to destroy it.

sense.text:
“For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication.” Why? Because she sitteth upon many nations, so she's able to spread her doctrine. And it says all nations — somehow, whether it's a millimetre, an inch, a foot or whatever, these nations have America's policies, their democracy and/or religions.

“and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her, and the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies.” And the merchants is their economic system.
“And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her; for no man buyeth their merchandise any more.”

“The merchandise of gold, and silver, and precious stones, and of pearls, and fine linen, and purple, and silk, and scarlet, and all thyine wood, and all manner vessels of ivory, and all manner vessels of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble, And cinnamon, and odours, and ointments, and frankincense, and wine, and oil, and fine flour, and wheat, and beasts, and sheep, and horses, and chariots, and slaves, and souls of men.”

Slaves and souls of men. Slaves and souls of who? The Israelites. Slaves and souls of the Israelites.

“Therefore shall her plagues come in one day, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire: for strong is the Lord God who judgeth her.” Her plagues come in one day. Death — that's that thermonuclear destruction. That hellfire.

God says she shall be utterly burned with fire.

“And cried when they saw the smoke of her burning, saying, What city is like unto this great city!” What city is like unto America?

But now it's what? A smoke that goes up for ever and ever and ever.

“For true and righteous are his judgments: for he hath judged the great whore, which did corrupt the earth with her fornication.” For true and righteous are his judgments.

“and hath avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.” The Most High is going to destroy them because of all the things that they did to us as far as spilling our blood. The prophets that are back here today, regenerated — some of them are going to be put to death right here in America. And not to exclude people like Nat Turner, Gabriel Prosser and so forth, who they already killed.
“And again they said, Alleluia. And her smoke rose up for ever and ever.” And her smoke rose up for ever and ever.

“And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet that wrought miracles before him.” And the beast is America — America and its system. The false prophet is going into the image of the beast; it's going into the white man. And all the miracles is the dropping of the atom bomb.

“with which he deceived them that had received the mark of the beast, and them that worshipped his image. These both were cast alive into a lake of fire burning with brimstone.” That lake of fire is hell. That's that hellfire. They were cast into the lake of fire burning with brimstone. The beast and the false prophet are there.

precepts.why:
“But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night.” Nuclear destruction.

“in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat.” And the elements shall melt with fervent heat. What can cause that? Nuclear missiles. This ain't regular missile fire. It's thermonuclear missiles. “the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.”

“Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness.” Seeing then — who's he talking to? He's talking to the Israelites now. Seeing then, you Israelites. What manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation? Now we have to walk circumspect. We have to be circumspect of what we do, because the time is at hand.

“And this shall be the plague wherewith the Lord will smite all the people that have fought against Jerusalem.” You hear that? This is the plague where God is going to smite all the people that had fought against Jerusalem. This is the controversy of Zion right here. The Most High is going to fight on our behalf.

“Their flesh shall consume away while they stand upon their feet.” Their flesh is going to consume away while they stand upon their feet. So before gravity can hit those bones of yours, before your bones could even hit the floor, hit the pavement, your skin is going to be melted away.

“and their eyes shall consume away in their holes, and their tongue shall consume away in their mouth.”

“Howl ye.” Howl. That's that pain. Why are you howling? From that pain of that nuclear fire.

“for the day of the Lord is at hand; it shall come as a destruction from the Almighty.” For the day of the Lord is at hand. It doesn't say rejoice. Howl. There's going to be a lot of weeping and gnashing of teeth. Christ said the same thing. And it shall come as a destruction from the Almighty.

We got to be circumspect, because we don't want that hellfire. We're already catching hell. We want to be delivered up out of this hell called captivity. We don't want the hell that Esau is going to get.

sense.text:
“Let us be glad and rejoice, and give honour to him.” So this is the mindset that we have to have, brothers and sisters. Let us be glad and rejoice and give honour to him, meaning Christ.

“for the marriage of the Lamb is come.” Prepare ourselves for this great feast, this great marriage with the Lamb.

“and his wife hath made herself ready.” And his wife hath made herself ready. We got to get our minds right.

How do you make yourself ready? “Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter.” So what's the conclusion of this whole class, of everything that we ever bring out, whether it's prophecy, history or law?

“Fear God, and keep his commandments.” Fear who? Fear God. Fear Yahawah. And keep his commandments — keep them to the best of your ability. Do your due diligence to keep his commandments.

“for this is the whole duty of man.” For this is the whole duty of man. This is the purpose. This is why we're breathing. This is why we wake up every day: to be the ambassadors of Christ and keep his commandments.

So we are hated, and we are in hell, but we can be saved from our hell. Esau is hated, and he will not be saved from his hell. Twelve tribes worldwide.
